Q: How can I yield list elements infinitely? A:

This is a solution by the means of while loop.

def gen():
    mylist = ["dir_1", "dir_2"]
    while True:
        for i in mylist:
            yield i

Q: Given several authorised public keys, how to identify the connected user from a Git hook? A:

Set ExposeAuthInfo yes in your server’s sshd_config and restart sshd. Limit this configuration to your specific user via Match User git. See https://serverfault.com/a/1092836
